scope: Rebuilt DVNM Bot as a unified CSS-drawn character with connected joints; removed segmented WebP rig from page rendering.
Added non-tear circular illuminated eyes and eyelids, head turns, speaking mouth, chest aura, arm gesture and leg-step illusions.
Strengthened responsive robot launcher and panel sizing and preserved keyboard access/reduced-motion behavior.
Refreshed light/dark color tokens, background gradients, card depth and visual contrast.
Added a unique locally stored illustrative SVG hero to each of the seven demo detail pages.
Removed the shared seven-demo card navigator from detail pages; all seven cards remain on Demo Studio index only.
Bumped CSS/JS and service-worker cache versions to v28.
image_generation: No new raster image generated; robot parts are alpha-masked derivatives of the existing supplied webp artwork and demo illustrations are hand-authored SVG.

bot.implementation: Unified CSS-drawn robot with connected joint geometry; current visible renderer does not use split robot image layers.

bot.speech_animation: Mouth opening and chest glow follow the active browser speech state approximately; this is not phoneme-perfect lip sync.
motions: small alternating step illusion with connected legs
